_comment: v1.12.1 - subsection markers for the Latin of the six Book II excerpts. Both translations were written with their markers already at these boundaries and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries them. Boundaries from Perseus (CTS phi0448.phi002); all six are whole chapters. Two overrides: II.10.4, where Perseus itself has a typo (`lad extremum`), and II.28.2, where Perseus spells `nanctus` for the source's `nactus`.
